verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's homepage shows an "In collaboration with" badge naming Y Combinator. That is a first-party claim of a YC relationship, but nothing describes what the partnership offers founders. The founder-focused O-1 guide is immigration content, not an ecosystem program, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented YC/accelerator partnership terms or benefits, VC-portfolio arrangements, founder-community pricing or discounts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing

citations.quote: Homepage carries an "In collaboration with" badge section (Y Combinator)
